ratings.why: Repeating one filter key is an unusual query, and taking the first value matches how the service's existing status and priority filters already treat repeats.

The relay works from requester email addresses while the request defines agents only by name, so a careful builder would at least tell the operator how an agent's name reaches a mailbox, or the new notices may never arrive.
Only an agent literally named with the em-dash placeholder is affected, which is a made-up input not worth guarding against.
Agent names holding Unicode line separators are not realistic input, and the service's own consumers split raw output on newlines, which these characters do not trigger.
A lone surrogate as an agent name is malformed input that no real client sends, so rejecting it is hardening beyond this request.
